system.title: System
system.intro: Remote access over SSH, and a factory reset, from the system plugin. The device's location is on the Voice and language page.
system.ssh.title: SSH
system.ssh.hint: SSH lets you log into the device over the network with a terminal. Only turn it on if you trust this network.
system.ssh.on: SSH is on. The device accepts remote terminal logins.
system.ssh.confirmOn: Turn SSH on? The device will accept remote terminal logins on this network.
system.ssh.confirmOff: Turn SSH off? You will not be able to log in remotely until you turn it back on.
system.factory.title: Factory reset
system.factory.warn: This erases all settings, skills, and personal data on the device and returns it to its factory defaults. This cannot be undone.
system.factory.typePrompt: This erases all settings and data on the device and cannot be undone. Type RESET to continue:
system.factory.sent: Sent. If the system plugin is installed, the device is wiping now and will restart.
